sc: Dioscuri Sentinel is a companion pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.

A doughnut is a food item that may be purchased for 10 coins from the Sandwich lady's bakery.
Random events were discontinued on 24 October 2012, and the Sandwich lady was later moved to a stall in Ardougne on 12 February 2013 where this item can be bought normally.
Unstrung dragon crossbows can be made through the Fletching skill at level 63 by using a mahogany stock with dragon limbs, granting 200 experience.
They are akin to chronicle fragments in that they may spawn randomly from an elder spring and grant Hunter experience based on the player's level when collected.
If the player wishes to complete the achievement as fast as possible, the pontifex observation ring (or its upgrade) is strongly recommended for its increased chronicle fragment spawn rate.
When an elder chronicle spawns, it will prompt the message .

sc: A small XP lamp (Hunter) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter.

Tellervo's net is a main-hand Hunter tool that can be found while searching hollow trees (not the stumps) in the Highweald Forest on Havenhythe.
It is possible to obtain multiples by storing each one in Fox's hunting supplies box, then searching hollow trees again.

It directed players where to place the items found in the lounge area.
Currently, it is not found in the bookcase of a player-owned house.
